description: The main window. The page it shows is the daemon's own web interface, served over loopback HTTP -- a REMOTE origin as far as Tauri is concerned, so IPC must be granted to it explicitly or every invoke is a silent no-op (window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__ simply never exists). That silence cost a release: the native dialogs, the parked-open pull and resolve_close all worked in no window at all. Only loopback is granted; this webview never navigates anywhere else, and a phone's browser has no Tauri to talk to.
